title: Not one person speaking in this Grok Imagine video actually exists
title_candidates: Not one person speaking in this Grok Imagine video actually exists
How Grok Imagine learned to fake lip sync and sound at the same time
What Grok Imagine looks like when it invents a face that can talk
The Grok Imagine demo where even the mouth movements are completely made up
Inside a Grok Imagine clip where every face, voice, and lip movement is invented
caption:
Grok Imagine made every face, voice, and lip movement in this video. None of it is real.

Getting lip sync right has been one of the hardest problems in AI video. The mouth has to match the audio frame by frame, and even small timing errors used to make it obvious. This clip shows how much closer Grok Imagine has gotten.

The usual signs that a video is AI, the blurring, the slight delay between sound and movement, are harder to spot now. The gap between AI video and real footage is closing faster than most people expected.
